headline: 《怒之杀》今日热度霸榜
summary: 今日（8月24日）暂无新片上映，本周已开画4部新片。热度方面，《怒之杀》领跑今日及本周趋势，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《玩具总动员5》等受关注，待映新片《最后的日出》引发期待。
summaryEn: No new films hit theaters today; four opened this week. Rage Kill leads daily and weekly trending, while Spider-Man: Brand New Day and Toy Story 5 draw attention. Upcoming The Last Sunrise is highly anticipated.

industryHighlights.en: No new films were released today (August 24).

industryHighlights.text: 本周已累计4部新片开画
industryHighlights.en: Four new films have opened this week so far.

industryHighlights.text: 《怒之杀》同时登顶今日与本周热搜
industryHighlights.en: Rage Kill tops both today's and this week's trending lists.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》《奥德赛》等进入本周热议榜单
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps and The Odyssey are among this week's hot titles.

industryHighlights.text: 备受期待的《最后的日出》即将上映
industryHighlights.en: Highly anticipated The Last Sunrise is coming soon.
